notes: Answered as Norma Jeane Mortenson / Marilyn Monroe (b. 1 June 1926, 09:30, Los Angeles County Hospital; d. 4 Aug 1962), strictly from documented public biography. No chart, horoscope or planetary material was consulted; verdicts/readings directories were not opened. Part D (post-reading feedback) is deliberately NOT answered: every D question asks about chapters of a reading I was instructed not to open, so any answer would be fabricated. Genuine ambiguities and judgement calls: A1/A2 the 09:30 a.m. time is Rodden-AA from the birth record, but 9:30 is a round half-hour as stated, hence 'round_hour' rather than 'exact'. A3 'no' refers to the time given here (the recorded one); third-party astrologers have published rectifications of her chart, but none is adopted. A8 the alleged 1927 smothering attempt by grandmother Della Monroe is reported in several biographies but treated sceptically by Spoto, so 'unknown'. A9 only the maternal grandparents are identified (Otis Monroe d. 1909 aged c.43; Della d. 1927 aged 51); paternity itself is contested (Mortensen on the certificate, C. Stanley Gifford in most accounts), so paternal grandparents are unknown. A11 father's fortunes unknowable given absent/disputed paternity. A12 'absent' not 'died_early' — Gladys Baker was institutionalised from 1934-35 onward but outlived her daughter (d. 1984). A13 half-brother Robert Kermitt Baker died in 1933 (she never knew him) and half-sister Berniece Miracle was met only in adulthood; 'distant' reflects the lived relationship, 'lost' is also literally true. A17 'own' reflects the 1954-55 Fox walkout, Marilyn Monroe Productions (1955) and the resulting contract/independent deals; the studio-contract years were the more lucrative but the more damaging. A23 'manageable' — chronic cash-flow and tax pressure despite high earnings, but no documented insolvency. A24 'divorced' is her status at death (Miller divorce final Jan 1961); A25 gives the first marriage (Dougherty, 19 June 1942); all three marriages ended, hence A27 'ended'. A29 endometriosis, an ectopic pregnancy (1957) and miscarriages (1956, 1958). A33 'over5' covers the New York years c.1955-1961; time actually abroad (England 1956, Korea 1954, Japan 1954, Mexico 1962) was months, not residence. A34 covers the Los Angeles Orphans Home (1935-37), a long chain of foster placements, and the Payne Whitney psychiatric admission (Feb 1961). A36 is anachronistic for a life that ended in 1962 and has no 'not applicable' option; 'same' is a null placeholder, not a claim. B2 'medium' — 5ft 5.5in with a well-documented fluctuating weight; B6#1 uses 'mother_death' for the mother's major illness/committal as the question's kind list allows. C3 weighed the Korea USO tour (a high point) against the miserable 1956 England shoot and settled on difficulty at low confidence. C9 reads as build/appearance (her greatest asset) since C10 separately carries general health, which was solidly difficult.
